# telnyx_mobile_voice_connection (Resource)

A connection for voice on Telnyx mobile SIM cards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_mobile_voice_connection" "example" {
  connection_name   = "Field team SIMs"
  active            = true
  webhook_event_url = "https://example.com/webhooks/mobile-voice"

  outbound = {
    outbound_voice_profile_id = telnyx_outbound_voice_profile.example.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Indicates if the connection is active.
- `connection_name` (String) The name of the connection.
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inbound))
- `outbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound))
- `tags` (Set of String) A list of tags associated with the connection.
- `webhook_api_version` (String) The API version for webhooks. One of `1`, `2`.
- `webhook_event_failover_url` (String) The failover URL where webhooks are sent.
- `webhook_event_url` (String) The URL where webhooks are sent.
- `webhook_timeout_secs` (Number) The timeout for webhooks in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
